title: Aug 3 — Aewol & West Jeju
text:
Monday · August 3, 2026 · Day 9 of 15
  Hallasan, Aewol & West Jeju 🏔️🍜🍵
  📍 Hallasan Mountain · Aewol Coastal Road · Noraba Ramen · Comma Cafe · Osulloc · Yeomiji · Jeju



Morning — Aewol Coast


  07:00
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · Cafe (12F) · Shilla Stay Jeju Airport
    Weekday hours: 06:30–09:30 · Buffet breakfast on the 12th floor. Breakfast included for the stay.
  



  08:30
  
    🏔️ Mountain
    Hallasan Mountain
    ~20 min drive straight south from the hotel along the 1100-ro road. Korea's highest peak (1,947m) and a UNESCO World Heritage site — the volcanic heart of Jeju.
      The 1100-ro entrance sits at mid-mountain elevation with dramatic views of the crater and surrounding forest. A short walk from the trailhead is enough to feel the scale of the mountain before heading to Aewol.
      
        ⚠️ NOTICE — Summit Reservation Required
        Hikers wishing to climb to the summit via the Seongpanak or Gwaneumsa trails must make a reservation online in advance.
        📋 Book Summit Trail → visithalla.jeju.go.kr
        For reservation assistance: Jeju Tourist Information Center · Open daily 09:00–18:00 KST
      
    
    
      📍 Hallasan
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  09:30
  
    🌊 Explore
    Aewol Coastal Road — Morning Walk
    ~20 min drive from the hotel. Jeju's most scenic coastal stretch — black lava rock coastline, ocean views, and the island's most famous cafe street.
      Things to explore:
      
        Handam Coastal Trail — easy 20–30 min paved walk between Gwakji Beach and Handam Village (part of Jeju Olle Trail 16)
        Gwakji Beach — calm beach famous for its scenery, great morning light
        Aewol Cafe Street — the most photogenic cafe strip in Jeju; great for a pre-Noraba coffee
      
    
    
      📍 Aewol Coast
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  10:00
  
    🍜 Brunch
    Noraba — Seafood Ramyeon
    🕐 10:00–17:00 · Break 14:00–15:00 · Closed Thursdays
      Fresh seafood ramyeon loaded with Jeju seasonal catch — crab, abalone, octopus, shrimp, mussels and clams in a mildly spicy broth. The abalone is served live. Ocean views from the window seats on the Aewol Coastal Road.
      ⚠️ Arrive right at opening (10:00) — 45-min queue is typical once it fills up.
    
    
      📍 Noraba
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — West & South Jeju


  12:30
  
    ☕ Cafe
    Comma Cafe
    Scenic west-coast cafe — a peaceful stop before heading into the tea country. Great for coffee and views of the coastline.
    
      📍 Comma Cafe
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  14:00
  
    🍵 Museum
    Osulloc Tea Museum
    Korea's premier green tea museum set amid rolling tea plantations. Surrounded by Innisfree's green tea fields (same company). Must-try:
      
        Osulloc green tea ice cream (삼다도 아이스크림)
        Fresh brewed premium green tea
        Tea field walk for photos
      
      Free admission to museum grounds and gardens. In-store experiences cost extra.
    
    
      📍 Osulloc
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  15:30
  
    🍜 Snack
    Jeju Sun Buckwheat Noodles (메밀국수)
    Jeju-style buckwheat noodles in a light broth — a regional specialty. The noodles are hand-made with an earthy, nutty flavour. A short drive from Osulloc.
    
      📍 Buckwheat Noodles
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  17:00
  
    🌸 Garden
    Yeomiji Botanical Garden
    Asia's largest botanical garden with 3,800+ species across themed greenhouses (tropical, subtropical, Mediterranean, desert) and outdoor gardens. The glass pyramids and cactus house are highlights. Entry ~₩14,000. Allow ~1 hour.
    
      📍 Yeomiji
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  19:00
  
    🥩 Dinner
    Myungho Manong Galbi — Garlic Galbi
    "Manong" means garlic in the Jeju dialect. Famous for tender, well-marinated short ribs (갈비) with garlic, paired with changachi guksu (chewy noodles) and soybean stew. Just a short drive from Yeomiji.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Last night in Jeju! Check out tomorrow morning — return rental car to Jeju One Car near the airport before your flight. Pack tonight. Noraba gets busy fast — arrive right at 10:00 to skip the worst of the queue.

title: Aug 1 — East Jeju
text:
Saturday · August 1, 2026 · Day 7 of 15
  East Jeju 🌅
  📍 Seongsan · Haenyeo Show · Gwangchigi Beach · Umu & Gamttanam · Jeju



Morning


  07:00
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · Cafe (12F) · Shilla Stay Jeju Airport
    Weekend hours: 07:00–10:00 (Weekdays: 06:30–09:30) · Buffet breakfast on the 12th floor. Breakfast is included for the entire stay.
  



  09:00
  
    🥾 Morning Hike
    Hike Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak)
    UNESCO World Heritage volcanic crater rising from the sea. Stunning panoramic views from the summit crater rim.
      🚗 ~55 min drive from Shilla Stay Jeju Airport. Tickets ₩2,000. Hike up takes 20–30 min (can be steep). Bring water and sunscreen — exposed trail in summer heat.
    
    
      📍 Seongsan Peak
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Midday


  11:30
  
    🐚 Lunch
    Jong Ga Abalone Restaurant (종가전복)
    🕐 Closes at 4:00 PM — go right after the hike while it's open.Fresh Jeju abalone on the north coast of Gujwa-eup. Haemajihaean-ro coastal road, right near Myeongjin Jeonbok. Known for abalone porridge (전복죽) and grilled abalone (전복구이).
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  13:30
  
    🤿 Show
    Haenyeo Diver Show
    Watch Jeju's legendary female free-divers (해녀) demonstrate their tradition of diving without equipment to harvest abalone, sea urchin, and seaweed. A living piece of UNESCO Intangible Heritage.
      🕑 Show starts at 2:00 PM daily — closed Mondays.
      ⚠️ Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot as it fills up quickly.
    
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Beach & Cafe


  15:00
  
    🏖️ Beach
    Gwangchigi Beach
    Scenic east-coast beach with black lava rocks and Seongsan Ilchulbong as a backdrop. Great for swimming or just relaxing.
    
      📍 Gwangchigi Beach
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:00
  
    🍺 Brewery
    Jeju Island Brewery
    🕐 10:30–17:00 · Closed SundaysCraft brewery on the east side of Jeju — a natural stop on the drive west from Gwangchigi Beach. Try their Jeju-inspired craft beers before heading to dinner.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  19:30
  
    FREE NIGHT🍽️ Dinner
    Free Night — Explore Near Hotel
    After a big day in East Jeju, wind down near the Shilla Stay area. Options:
      
        Seafood restaurants along Jeju port
        Dongmun Market for street food and snacks
        Jeju-style galchi (hairtail fish) near the hotel
      
    
    
      📍 Find Dinner
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Breakfast included at Shilla Stay Jeju Airport (12F Cafe) — weekday 06:30–09:30, weekend 07:00–10:00. Today is Saturday so buffet runs until 10:00. Drive to Seongsan is ~55 min.

title: Jul 27 — Arrive Seoul
text:
Monday · July 27, 2026 · Day 2 of 15
  Arrive Seoul 🛬
  📍 Incheon Airport → Myeongdong · Hotel: Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station
  ✅ Finalized



Afternoon — Arrival


  16:05
  
    ✈️ Arrival
    Arrive Incheon International Airport (ICN)
    Clear immigration, collect luggage, then head straight to the SIM card pick-up before exiting. Take Airport Limousine Bus.
    
      📍 ICN Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:20
  
    BOOKED ✓ Klook📱 SIM Card
    Pick Up LG U+ SIM Cards (×2) — Includes Free T-Money Card
    
      2 physical SIM cards pre-booked on Klook · LG U+ network
      
        Validity: 15 days
        Data: Unlimited
        Calls & texts included (with extra top-up option)
        Each SIM comes with a free T-Money card — no need to buy one separately
      
      Pick-up locations at T1 Arrivals (1F):
      
        ⭐ Gate A — 06:00–22:00 · Recommended for faster service
        Gate F — 00:00–23:59 (24hr, use if arriving very late)
      
      Head to Gate A counter first — shorter wait times.
    
    
      📍 Gate A, T1 Arrivals
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:45
  
    🚌 Limousine Bus
    Airport Limousine Bus → Shilla Stay Seodaemun
    
      Buy tickets at the kiosks or staffed counters inside T1 Arrivals, then head outside to T1, 1F, Stop No. 5. Two routes both go directly to the hotel:

      Drop-off: Seodaemun Station Sageori — right at the hotel entrance. Both routes use the same stop.
    
    
      📍 T1 Stop No. 5
      🗺 Naver
      🌐 Route Info
    
  



  17:30
  
    🏨 Check-in
    Check In · Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station
    Home base for the first Seoul leg (Jul 27–30). Near Seoul Station for easy city access. The #6002/#6005 bus stops nearby — confirm the drop-off point with the driver.
    
      📍 Hotel Map
      🗺 Naver
    
  




  18:00
  
    🚇 Subway
    Shilla Stay → Gwangjang Market by Subway
    
      
        Board at Seodaemun Station on Line 5 Purple — direction Gwanghwamun
        Ride 4 stops and get off at Euljiro 4-ga Station
        Walk ~4 minutes to Gwangjang Market
      
      Total trip time: ~11 minutes
    
    
      📍 Seodaemun Station
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner — Choose One


  18:30
  
    🥟 Option A
    Gwangjang Market
    Seoul's oldest market. Famous for: Bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes)Mayak gimbap (bite-sized rolls)Yukhoe (Korean beef tartare)Great atmosphere day and night.
    
      📍 Gwangjang Market
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:30
  
    🥟 Option B⚠️ Closes 19:30
    Gamekol Son Wangmandu
    Hand-made giant dumplings. Closes at 19:30 — go early or skip to Gwangjang.
    
      📍 Gamekol Map
      🗺 Naver
    
  


  19:30
  
    🚌 Bus
    Gwangjang Market → Myeongdong by Bus 104
    
      
        Board Bus 104 near Gwangjang Market
        Get off at Toegye-ro 2-ga stop
        Head to Myeongdong Station Exit 7
      
      Total trip time: ~13 minutes
    
    
      📍 Gwangjang Market
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Evening — Myeongdong


  19:45
  
    🛍️ Shopping
    Explore Myeongdong
    One of Seoul's most iconic shopping & street food districts. Packed with K-beauty, fashion, and snacks.
    
      📍 Myeongdong
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  19:45
  
    💄 Beauty
    Olive Young Haul
    Korea's biggest K-beauty chain. Tax-free shopping available with passport. Stock up on sheet masks, sunscreens, toners.
    
      📍 Olive Young Myeongdong
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  19:45
  
    🍽️ Dinner
    NYU NYU Myeongdong
    Popular snack stop in Myeongdong.
    
      📍 NYU NYU
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  21:45
  
    🚌 Bus
    Myeongdong to Shilla Stay
    GPS back home - expect 20mins - Most likely we'd have to bus home - If subway then we'd have to take Line 4 (Blue) then transfer at Gwanghui-dong, take Line 5
  

Late Night (Back by 22:10)

  💤
  
    😴 Jet Lag Strategy
    Arrival Day Sleep Plan — Survive Tonight
    
      You land at 16:05 KST but your body clock reads midnight Vancouver time. The key is to hold out until a reasonable Korean bedtime without crashing early. One bad nap now can knock your sleep schedule off for days.
      

        
          16:05–18:00 KST00:05–02:00 PDT
          ⚠️ Do NOT nap — even lying down "just for 20 min" will become 3 hours. Get the SIM, take the bus, check in, and go straight outside. Movement helps.
        

        
          18:00–21:00 KST02:00–05:00 PDT
          Stay busy — Bright lights, food, and walking are your best friend right now. Eat a proper dinner even if you're not hungry.
        

        
          21:00–22:00 KST05:00–06:00 PDT
          😴 Bedtime — this is your target. Take a melatonin (0.5–1mg), shower, black out the room. Don't fight it past 22:00 — earlier is fine.
        

        
          07:00–08:00 KST15:00–16:00 PDT
          Wake up — set an alarm. Your body clock will likely wake you earlier (Vancouver afternoon = Seoul early morning). Get up, open curtains, get sunlight. Day 2 starts fresh. ☀️
        

      
      ☀️ Sunlight is the strongest reset signal — get outside in the morning on Day 2 (Jul 28). Breakfast on the hotel terrace or a walk before the Gangnam day helps lock in your new rhythm.
    
  


Breakfast included at hotel daily. · T-Money: comes free with your LG U+ SIM — top it up at any convenience store or subway machine.

title: Aug 4 — Jeju → Busan
text:
Tuesday · August 4, 2026 · Day 10 of 15
  Jeju → Busan ✈️🌊
  📍 Jeju Airport → Busan · Haeundae Beach · Haeundae Market · Anmok
  ✅ Finalized



Morning — Departure


  06:30
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · Cafe (12F) · Shilla Stay Jeju Airport
    Weekday hours: 06:30–09:30 · Last morning at the hotel — eat early to leave time before the flight.
  



  08:30
  
    🚗 Return Car
    Check Out · Return Rental Car — Jeju One Car
    Check out of Shilla Stay Jeju Airport. Return rental car to Jeju One Car near the airport — quick drop-off since it's right next door.
    
      📍 Jeju Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  09:30
  
    🍽️ Extra · IF Time Allows
    DOTOREE Kitchen (optional)
    Only if you have time after returning the car. Skip if running behind — the flight at 13:00 is the priority.
      ⚠️ Must leave by 11:00 to reach Jeju Airport by 11:30 — giving 1.5 hours before departure. Domestic check-in closes ~40 min before.
    
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Flight to Busan


  13:00
  
    ✈️ Departure
    Depart Jeju → Busan (Gimhae)
    ~55 min flight from Jeju (CJU) to Busan Gimhae International Airport (PUS).
    
      📍 CJU Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  14:05
  
    🛬 Arrival
    Arrive Busan — Gimhae Airport (PUS)
    Take the Busan-Gimhae Light Railway (BGL) or bus to Haeundae. Journey ~1 hour to Haeundae Beach area.
    
      📍 PUS Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:00
  
    BOOKED ✓🏨 Check-in
    Check In — L7 Haeundae by Lotte Hotels
    55 Haeun-daero 570beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan. 3 nights (Aug 4–6). Breakfast included — buffet at Floating restaurant, 2F. Rated 9.5/10 (2,540 reviews).
    
      📍 L7 Haeundae
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Evening


  17:00
  
    🏖️ Beach
    Haeundae Beach
    Korea's most famous beach — 1.5km of white sand. Busy in summer but the atmosphere is electric. Great for a sunset stroll or a dip. Marine City skyline makes for a dramatic backdrop.
    
      📍 Haeundae Beach
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:00
  
    🛒 Market
    Haeundae Market
    Traditional market steps from the beach. Great for Busan street food — ssiat hotteok (seed-stuffed hotteok), pajeon (seafood pancake), and fresh fish.
    
      📍 Haeundae Market
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  19:30
  
    🍽️ Dinner
    Anmok
    Dinner at Anmok near Haeundae — a local favourite for fresh Busan-style dining.
    
      📍 Anmok
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Sky Capsule tomorrow — book 1 month ahead if possible. Very popular. Check availability at Haeundae Blueline Park website.

title: Jul 30 — DMZ + Euljiro
text:
Thursday · July 30, 2026 · Day 5 of 15
  DMZ + Euljiro 🪖
  📍 DMZ (6–7 hrs) · Seolleongtang · Euljiro Hidden Alleys · Hannam · Seoul
  ✅ Finalized



Morning — DMZ Tour


  06:30
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · CAFE (B1F) · Shilla Stay
    Thursday (Weekday) hours: 06:30–09:30 · ₩23,000/adult · Go early today — DMZ tour departs at 08:00. Be down by 06:30–07:00 to eat and leave by 07:20.
  



  07:20
  
    🚇 Getting There
    Hotel → Myeongdong Station Exit 8
    
      Head to the group tour meeting point. Must arrive before 08:00.
      📍 125 Toegye-ro, Jung District, Seoul — outside Myeongdong Station Exit 8
    
    
      📍 Meeting Point
    
  



  08:00
  
    BOOKED ✓🪖 Tour
    DMZ Group Tour (6–7 hours)
    Group bus departs from Myeongdong Station Exit 8. Guided tour of the Demilitarized Zone between North and South Korea. Typically includes:
      
        Third Infiltration Tunnel
        Dora Observatory (views into North Korea)
        Dorasan Station (the northernmost station in South Korea)
        Imjingak Park
      
      Bring your passport. No large cameras allowed in tunnels.
    
    
      📍 Myeongdong Exit 8
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Late Lunch


  15:00
  
    🍲 Late Lunch
    Oegojip Seolleongtang
    Milky white ox bone broth soup (설렁탕) simmered for hours. Rich, comforting, and perfect after a long morning tour. Season to taste with salt and green onion.
    
      📍 Oegojip
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Euljiro Area


  16:30
  
    ☕ Explore
    Euljiro — Cafes, Record Stores & Hidden Alleys
    One of Seoul's coolest areas — industrial streets being turned into indie cafes, galleries and record shops hidden among printing workshops. Explore:
      
        Third wave coffee cafes in old factories
        Vinyl record stores (crates of K-pop and jazz)
        Hidden back alleyways and neon-lit courtyards
      
    
    
      📍 Euljiro Area
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  18:30
  
    🍗 Dinner
    한남동한방통닭 — Hannam Oriental Rotisserie Chicken
    Slow-roasted whole chicken with Korean herbal spices. Crispy skin, juicy meat, incredible flavour. The Hannam neighbourhood is also worth a wander after dinner.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Breakfast included at hotel. · Pack light for the DMZ — security checks at the zone. Passport required. · Last full day in Seoul before Jeju!

title: Aug 7 — Busan → Seoul
text:
Friday · August 7, 2026 · Day 13 of 15
  Busan → Seoul 🚄
  📍 KTX · Ikseon Chwihyang · Seongsu Food Crawl · Yunjudang · Korean BBQ Dr. Hong · Seoul
  🔧 Needs Fixes



Morning — KTX to Seoul


  10:00–11:00
  
    🚄 KTXBuy in advance
    KTX: Busan Station → Seoul Station
    High-speed train from Busan to Seoul. Target departure between 10:00–11:00 AM. Journey time ~2h 15m. Buy tickets on the Korail website or at the station. Busan KTX station is at Busan Station (city centre).
      
        Check korail.com for tickets
        Seat reservations recommended — window seat for scenery
        Arrive Seoul ~12:30–13:00
      
    
    
      📍 Busan Station
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Lunch — Ikseon-dong


  12:30
  
    🍝 Lunch
    Ikseon Chwihyang — Famous Pasta
    Famous pasta restaurant in Ikseon-dong, Seoul's charming hanok village district. Stop here straight off the KTX before hotel check-in — Ikseon-dong is a short hop from Seoul Station area.
      
        The neighbourhood itself is beautiful — old Korean houses converted into cafes and restaurants
        Great post-train meal before heading to drop luggage
      
    
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Check In & Seongsu


  14:00
  
    ⚠️ Hotel TBD🏨 Check-in
    Check In — Voco Myeongdong or Gangnam (TBD)
    Hotel for final nights (Aug 7–8) still to be confirmed — Voco Myeongdong or Voco Gangnam. Drop luggage and head to Seongsu for the afternoon.
    
    
      📍 Voco Myeongdong
      📍 Voco Gangnam
    
  



  15:30
  
    🌳 Park
    Seoul Forest
    Urban forest park with deer, wetlands, and outdoor art. Great for a relaxing post-train walk through greenery before the Seongsu food crawl.
    
      📍 Seoul Forest
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:30
  
    🛍️ Last Shopping
    Seongsu — Trendy Boutique District
    Seoul's Brooklyn — converted warehouses turned into independent boutiques, concept stores, and cafes. Great for unique finds and designer Korean brands.
    
      📍 Seongsu
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Food Crawl — Seongsu


  17:00
  
    🍰 Bakery
    Ggupdang Seongsu
    Popular Seongsu bakery known for crispy pastry cream buns. Usually has a queue — get there early or during off-peak hours.
    
      📍 Ggupdang
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  17:30
  
    🍓 Dessert
    Rafre Fruit Dessert Cafe Seongsu
    Seasonal fruit dessert cafe — elaborate fruit tarts, fruit shaved ice, and fruit-forward drinks. Beautiful and photogenic.
    
      📍 Rafre
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:00
  
    ☕ Cafe
    Soil & Tree
    Specialty coffee and natural-focused cafe in the Seongsu area.
    
      📍 Soil & Tree
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  18:30
  
    🍵 PM Snack⏰ Closes 5–9pm
    Yunjudang (윤주당) — Brew Master Yun
    Famous local spot — make sure to stop before it closes (5pm–9pm window). A must-try PM snack in the Seongsu area.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  20:00
  
    🔥 BBQ Dinner
    Korean BBQ Dr. Hong
    Korean BBQ — a great penultimate dinner spot to cap the last full Seongsu day.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Only 2 more full days in Korea! Tomorrow: COEX, K-pop buildings, head spa, and final shopping. Plan your last must-buys tonight. Also confirm hotel (Voco Myeongdong vs Gangnam) and update this page.

title: Jul 29 — Palace & Hanbok
text:
Wednesday · July 29, 2026 · Day 4 of 15
  Palace & Hanbok Day 👘
  📍 Gyeongbokgung · Bukchon · Seochon · Seoul Forest · Euljiro · Seoul
  ✅ Finalized



Morning — Hanbok & Palace


  07:30
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · CAFE (B1F) · Shilla Stay
    Wednesday (Weekday) hours: 06:30–09:30 · ₩23,000/adult · Arrive by 09:00 — strict closing. Early start today for 09:00 hanbok booking.
  



  09:00
  
    BOOKED ✓👘 Experience
    Studio KJD — Hanbok Rental (2.5 hrs)
    Traditional Korean hanbok dress-up + photo experience. 2.5 hours included — walk directly to Gyeongbokgung in hanbok for the full experience.
    
      📍 Studio KJD
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  09:30
  
    🏯 Sightseeing
    Gyeongbokgung Palace
    Korea's main royal palace. Free entry in hanbok! Changing of the guard ceremony at 10:00 and 14:00. One of Seoul's most photogenic spots.
    
      📍 Gyeongbokgung
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  11:00
  
    🏘️ Village
    Bukchon Hanok Village
    Preserved traditional Korean houses on a hillside. Best explored in hanbok in the morning before crowds arrive. Instagram-famous alleyway on Gahoe-ro 11-gil.
    
      📍 Bukchon
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Lunch — Seochon


  12:00
  
    🍜 Lunch
    Jalpajin Buckwheat Seochon Main
    Artisan buckwheat noodle restaurant in the charming Seochon (West Village) neighbourhood near the palace.
    
      📍 Jalpajin
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Explore


  13:30
  
    🍮 Dessert
    Dotori Garden Anguk — Persimmon Dessert
    Specialty dessert cafe near Anguk station serving beautiful persimmon-based sweets. A unique Korean dessert experience. Close to Bukchon — easy walk after lunch.
    
      📍 Dotori Garden
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  14:00
  
    🍞 Snack
    Jayeondo Salt Bread (소금빵)
    Crispy, buttery Korean-style salt bread — a must-try street snack. Steps from Dotori Garden. Quick stop before heading to Yeouido.
    
      📍 Salt Bread Shop
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  14:30
  
    🚲 Bikes
    Yeouido Hangang Park — Bike Rental
    Rent bikes at Yeouido Hangang Park and cruise the Han River path. ⚠️ Bike rental closes at 5:00 PM — must return by then. Grab snacks from a nearby convenience store to enjoy riverside while you ride.
    
      📍 Yeouido Hangang Park
      🗺 Naver
    
  


Dinner


  Option 1

  13:00

      📍 논현삼계탕
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  13:00
  
    🍲 Lunch Option 2
    KimbuksoonKeunNambijip — Kimchi Jjigae
    Alternative lunch option — kimchi jjigae (kimchi stew) done right. A bubbling hot pot of aged kimchi, tofu, pork, and broth. One of Korea's most comforting dishes and a great farewell Korean meal.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver

  14:30

      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver

  20:30

Before You Leave — Pre-Departure Checklist


  Jul 23
  
    📋 3 Days Before
    Fill Out Korea e-Arrival Card
    Korean immigration requires an electronic arrival card submitted up to 3 days before arrival. Complete it at e-arrivalcard.go.kr. Have your passport, flight number, and accommodation address (Shilla Stay Seodaemun) ready. Saves significant time at immigration on arrival.
    
      🌐 e-arrivalcard.go.kr
    
  



  Jul 24–25
  
    ✈️ 24–48 hrs Before
    Online Check-In
    Check in online with your airline to choose seats and download boarding passes. Most airlines open check-in 24 hours before departure. Having mobile boarding passes avoids a queue at the airport.
  



  Tonight
  
    🎒 Packing List
    Packing List
    
      Documents
      
        ✅ Passport (valid 6+ months)
        ✅ Korea e-Arrival Card (completed)
      
      Electronics
      
        ✅ Phone + charger
        ✅ Universal adapter (Korea uses Type C/F, 220V)
        ✅ Portable charger / power bank
        ✅ Camera + memory cards
        ✅ Earbuds / headphones (for flight)
      
      Clothing
      
        ✅ Light layers (summer in Korea is hot & humid, ~28–33°C)
        ✅ Rain jacket / compact umbrella (summer is monsoon season)
        ✅ Comfortable walking shoes (cobblestone streets at palaces)
        ✅ Smart casual outfit for nicer dinners
        ✅ Light jacket for cave (Manjanggul is 11°C inside)
      
      Health & Toiletries
      
        ✅ Sunscreen (SPF 50+ — Korea summer sun is intense)
        ✅ Medications + any prescriptions
        ✅ Lip balm, hand cream (plane is dry)
      
      Money & Cards
      
        ✅ Korean Won cash (₩200,000–300,000 for first day)
        ✅ Credit card with no foreign transaction fees
      
      Miscellaneous
      
        ✅ Neck pillow + eye mask (overnight flight)
        ✅ Snacks for the flight
        ✅ Reusable water bottle
        ✅ Tote bag (for shopping / day trips)
        ✅ Small daypack for hikes (Seongsan, DMZ)
      
    
  


Afternoon — Departure


  13:00
  
    
      ✈️ Departure
    
    Depart Vancouver (YVR)
    International terminal. Arrive at least 3 hours early for international check-in. Korea Air / Air Canada routing to ICN. Cross the International Date Line — arrive July 27.
    
      📍 YVR Airport
      🗺 Naver
    
  


Evening / Overnight


  —
  
    ✈️ In-Flight
    Overnight flight to Seoul (ICN)
    Flight time ~11 hours. Gain 16 hours crossing the date line. Arrive Seoul the next day (Jul 27) at 16:05 KST.
  



  💤
  
    😴 Jet Lag Strategy
    In-Flight Sleep Plan — Reset to KST
    
      Vancouver → Seoul crosses 16 time zones eastward — the tougher direction. The goal is to land at 16:05 KST feeling functional, then push through to 21:00 KST bedtime. Follow this flight plan:
      
        

          
            13:00–15:00 PDT05:00–07:00 KST
            Stay awake — it's afternoon for your body. Eat the meal service, watch a movie, get settled.
          

          
            15:00–15:30 PDT07:00–07:30 KST
            Wind down — take melatonin (0.5–1mg low dose works best), put on eye mask and neck pillow, recline seat.
          

          
            15:30–22:00 PDT07:30–14:00 KST
            😴 SLEEP — aim for ~6 hours. This is the critical window. Even if it feels unnatural (your body says it's afternoon), use the eye mask, earplugs, and blanket. Avoid checking the time.
          

          
            22:00–00:05 PDT14:00–16:05 KST
            Wake up — ~2 hrs before landing. Freshen up, eat the pre-landing meal, open the window shade, get into Seoul headspace. ☀️
          

          
            16:05 KST00:05 PDT
            Land in Seoul — your body thinks it's midnight, but it's 4pm in Korea. The plan from here is on the Jul 27 page. 🇰🇷
          

        
      
      💊 Melatonin tip: low dose (0.5mg) taken 30 min before your target sleep time works better than the standard 5mg pill. Available at Shoppers Drug Mart before the flight.
    
  

Tip: T-money transit card comes free with your LG U+ SIM — pick up the SIM at Gate A, T1 Arrivals right after landing.

title: Aug 5 — Haeundae Day
text:
Wednesday · August 5, 2026 · Day 11 of 15
  Haeundae Day 🏖️
  📍 Sky Capsule · Jangteo Gukbap · Haedong Temple · Standard Bread · Sunset · 첨벙 · Busan
  🔧 Needs Fixes



Breakfast — L7 Haeundae


  07:00–10:00
  
    INCLUDED ✓🍳 Breakfast Buffet
    Floating Restaurant — Breakfast Buffet
    Signature buffet with healthy dishes made from fresh seasonal ingredients and Busan local delicacies. Located on the 2F.
      
        Hours: 07:00–10:00 — don't miss closing time
        Breakfast included in your booking — no extra charge
      
    
    
      📍 L7 Haeundae
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Morning — Sky Capsule


  08:30–09:00
  
    BOOKED ✓🚡 Ride
    Sky Capsule (Cheongsapo Departure) — Haeundae Blueline Park
    Pastel-coloured glass pod trains that ride along a coastal rail above the sea cliffs. One of Busan's most iconic and photogenic experiences. Reservation confirmed — entry window is 8:30–9:00 AM.
      
        ~2.7km coastal route from Mipo to Cheongsapo
        Pods seat 2 people, ~30 min round trip
        Best views looking out to sea on the left side going northbound
      
    
    
      📍 Sky Capsule

      🎫 Retrieve Ticket
    
  

Lunch


  12:00
  
    🍲 MUST EAT
    DWAEJI GUKBAP!!!!! — Jangteo Gukbap
    Busan's most iconic dish — pork soup with rice (돼지국밥). A thick, milky white pork bone broth with tender pork slices and rice. Season with fermented shrimp (새우젓) and green onion. Jangteo Gukbap is right in the Haeundae beach area.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Temple & Cafe


  14:30
  
    🏯 Temple
    Haedong Yonggungsa Temple
    Rare and stunning Buddhist temple built directly on seaside cliffs. Dragons, pagodas, and golden Buddhas overlooking crashing waves — one of Korea's most dramatic temple settings. ~30 min from Haeundae by taxi/bus.
      
        Enter through the stone archway at the top and descend to the sea level temple
        Best visited in afternoon when morning crowds thin
        Souvenir stalls and fish-shaped bread (붕어빵) at the entrance
      
    
    
      📍 Haedong Temple
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:30
  
    🍞 Cafe
    Standard Bread Haeundae — French Toast
    Say no more — famous for their French toast. A must-stop cafe in the Haeundae area.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Evening


  18:30
  
    🌅 Sunset
    Haeundae Beach Sunset
    Watch the sun set over Haeundae Beach with the Marine City skyscrapers as a silhouette. The beach lights up beautifully at dusk. Perfect for golden-hour photos.
    
      📍 Haeundae Beach
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  19:30
  
    🐟 Dinner
    첨벙 Cheombeong — Sashimi
    Fresh sashimi dinner in Busan. One of the best spots near Haeundae for high-quality raw fish (회).
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Sky Capsule booking: Reservation confirmed for 8:30–9:00 AM entry (Cheongsapo Departure). Log in to retrieve the ticket at tbluelinepark.com/mypage/login_eng/GD2100048.

title: Aug 2 — Nature Day
text:
Sunday · August 2, 2026 · Day 8 of 15
  Nature Day 🌿
  📍 Manjanggul Cave · Haenyeo Gimbap · 통일가든 · Stone Park · Eco Land · Sangumburi · Gyulbate · Jeju



Morning


  07:00
  
    🍳 Breakfast
    Breakfast Buffet · Cafe (12F) · Shilla Stay Jeju Airport
    Weekend hours: 07:00–10:00 (Weekdays: 06:30–09:30) · Buffet breakfast on the 12th floor. Breakfast included for the stay.
  



  09:00
  
    🕍 Cave⚠️ Check Status
    Manjanggul Lava Tube Cave
    One of the world's longest lava tubes — a UNESCO World Heritage site. Walk through a cathedral-like underground tunnel carved by ancient lava flows. The 7.4km tube has a 1km section open to visitors. Check reopening status before visiting — periodic closures for maintenance.
      
        Temperature inside: ~11°C year-round — bring a light jacket
        Wear non-slip shoes
        Entry: ~₩4,000
      
    
    
      📍 Manjanggul
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Lunch — On the Drive Back


  11:00
  
    🍱 Snack
    Haenyeogimbap — Gimbap by the Sea
    On the drive west from Manjanggul — stop here first while still on the north coast. Fresh haenyeo-style gimbap using locally-caught sea ingredients. A unique Jeju version of the classic Korean rice roll.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  12:00
  
    🍜 Lunch
    통일가든 — Cold Black Bean Noodles
    Continue west from Haenyeogimbap — a short drive away. Cold black bean noodles (물냉면/짜장) — refreshing and hearty before the afternoon nature loop.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Afternoon — Nature Loop


  14:00
  
    🗿 Nature
    Jeju Stone Park (돌문화공원)
    Vast outdoor park celebrating Jeju's volcanic stone culture and mythology. Features hundreds of stone statues (dol hareubang), lava rock formations, and traditional thatched homes set across a sweeping landscape.
    
      📍 Jeju Stone Park
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  15:00
  
    🌳 Park
    Eco Land Theme Park
    Right next to Stone Park. Scenic park with a vintage train ride through forests and past wetlands. Good for a relaxed afternoon ride through Jeju's countryside.
    
      📍 Eco Land
      🗺 Naver
    
  



  16:30
  
    🌿 Nature
    Sangumburi Crater
    A perfectly circular volcanic crater filled with 420+ plant species. Stunning panoramic walk around the rim. Entry: ~₩3,000. About 30 min loop walk.
    
      📍 Sangumburi
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Evening


  17:30
  
    🍊 Cafe
    Gyulbate — Tangerine Cafe
    Heading south toward dinner — stop here on the way. Jeju tangerine (귤) focused cafe. Try the fresh squeezed tangerine juice or tangerine latte — made from Jeju hallabong, the island's signature citrus.
    
      📍 Google Maps
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Dinner


  19:30
  
    FREE NIGHT🍽️ Dinner
    Dinner — South Jeju
    Find something in the south Jeju area — seafood, galchi (hairtail fish), or local Jeju cuisine recommended since we already had pork BBQ on Jul 31.
      🔀 Option: Ppolsaljip — Korean BBQ nearby if the group is craving it.
    
    
      📍 Find Dinner
      🗺 Naver
    
  

Cave tip: Bring a light jacket — Manjanggul is 11°C inside regardless of outside temperature. Wear closed-toe shoes for the cave floor. Weekend breakfast: 07:00–10:00.
